title: Spines of the Geode Cavern
story: Inside a cavern of purple crystal, Quarrowspine the Geode Serpent coils around the miners' only ladder, bristling with 42 quartz spines. Every time Mr 6's frost-sword shatters some spines, more crackle back out of the serpent's hide. Mr 6 sits on a boulder and counts before he swings even once.
question: Each swing shatters 6 spines, but 2 new spines grow back right after — unless no spines are left at all. How many swings does Mr 6 need to clear all 42 spines?
solution: Each swing except the last has a net effect of 6 - 2 = 4 spines gone.
Mr 6 needs the count down to 6 so one final swing finishes it: (42 - 6) / 4 = 9 swings to get there.
Then 1 last swing clears the final 6, so 9 + 1 = 10 swings.
praise: Tracking the regrowth was the clever part — the step that was missing is that the very last swing has nothing left to regrow, so it counts on its own.
hint: Every swing but the FINAL one only removes 4 spines on balance. How many spines should be left right before that last swing?
victory: On the tenth swing the last spine chimes like a bell and Quarrowspine, suddenly smooth as a river stone, slithers off to nap — the miners keep the crystals and Mr 6 keeps his notes.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight with a frost-glowing sword facing a great serpent bristling with violet quartz spines in a glittering geode cavern, cool blue-purple light and awed miners peeking from a ladder.
